question.text:
Statement $(P \Rightarrow Q) \wedge(R \Rightarrow Q)$ is logically equivalent to :

  1. $(P \Rightarrow R) \wedge(Q \Rightarrow R)$
     
  2. $(P \Rightarrow R) \vee(Q \Rightarrow R)$
     
  3. $(P \wedge R) \Rightarrow Q$
     
  4. $(P \vee R) \Rightarrow Q$
question.subject: Mathematical Logic
